_comment: Kokoro-only pronunciations (build-podcast.py --engine kokoro). Same keys as pronunciations.json (whole word, case-insensitive, longest first). A value wrapped in slashes, e.g. "/mˈɛʤəɡˌɔɹjə/", is misaki phonemes and is sent as Kokoro's inline hint [Word](/phonemes/), which is NOT read aloud. Any other value is a plain-text replacement. Keys missing here fall back to the original word (Kokoro's own G2P + espeak-ng), never to the hyphenated edge respellings, which Kokoro reads choppy (stress on every syllable). Misaki symbols: A=ay, I=eye, O=oh, W=ow, Y=oy, ʤ=j, ʧ=ch, ʃ=sh, ɹ=r, ˈ primary / ˌ secondary stress.
